name: manual_0c339d
claim: An agent renaming a directory/binary must never also infer a broader identity change (module path, package namespace, org identity) in the same commit unless explicitly authorized — each identity-bearing change needs its own explicit human sign-off, even when bundled with an authorized structural rename

decisions.notes: A Cursor Cloud Agent was authorized only to rename cmd/agentsview/ -> cmd/periscope/ in periscope's diazMelgarejo/periscope fork (commit 485bee59, 2026-07-28). It also silently changed go.mod's module declaration from go.kenn.io/agentsview to github.com/latentsignal-org/periscope in the same commit, under the operator's own git identity (no Co-Authored-By trailer). That module path had no basis anywhere: neither latentsignal-org/periscope@main nor kenn-io/agentsview (the real current upstream) ever used it -- both still declare go.kenn.io/agentsview. The unauthorized change propagated silently across 142 downstream commits and 614 files before being caught, and required a full mechanical revert (2026-08-03) once discovered via direct verification against live upstream sources (raw.githubusercontent.com), not assumption.

PR #321 CodeRabbit remediation 2026-08-03: live go.mod re-verify shows latentsignal-org/periscope@main declares module github.com/wesm/agentsview, not go.kenn.io/agentsview. Append-only supersession: lesson_d7f233fdd47e supersedes lesson_0c339d39a80c. Original graduated notes retained unchanged as audit evidence of the incorrect claim.
